Country.evidence_source: Participants were recruited from a large Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare system in the southeastern United States.

Population.evidence_source: This qualitative study explored the role of spirituality/religion in the lives of US Veterans with suicidal ideation and/or a history of suicide attempt.
